queries_run: Trane Technologies credit rating downgrade OR outlook 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露無單一外部客戶占合併營收超過10%（2023–2025），亦無重大依賴單一或少數客戶。
findings.excerpt: We have no single external customer that accounted for more than 10% of our consolidated net revenues in 2025, 2024 or 2023. No material part of our business is dependent upon a single customer or a small group of customers; therefore, the loss of any one customer would not have a material adverse effect on our results of operations or cash flows.
